subject: Access pact & kickoff: Brightly Health workspace and API key plan
thread_text:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlyhealth.com>, onboarding@brightlyhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access pact & kickoff: Brightly Health workspace and API key plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for signing; excited to get Brightly Health into a live workspace. This thread is the implementation handoff so the implementation team has the context and the initial asks listed below.

High-level goal: enable Brightly to call Redwood API from their staging environment by the end of week of Nov 17.

What we need from Brightly for initial provisioning (asks to confirm):
- Admin user(s): one person who will be granted Organization Admin role (name + email).
- Project name: please confirm the project/namespace we should create (recommended: brightly-staging).
- Service account(s): whether you prefer a user-level API key or a service account managed in your vault.
- SRE contact and IP allowlist window (if you require regional IP restrictions).

What Redwood will deliver for kickoff:
- Create org workspace and seed initial API key (ephemeral and/or long-lived options).
- Upload admin role matrix CSV and run key-seeding exercise with your SRE.
- Provide step-by-step seed instructions + example curl/SDK snippets.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) Confirm Admin user + project name by EOD Wed Nov 5.
2) Internal prep & seeding plan (we will prepare key template and runbook) — target Nov 6.
3) Kickoff call to run through SSO/API key seeding — propose Nov 10 or Nov 11 (30 min).

Ben/Rishi — I have cc'd you to pick this up for seeding and to prepare the SOW and seed template. I will attach the signed SOW and a key-seed template to the internal follow-up.

Attachments: rbw_key_seed_template.csv (template for admin role), SOW_Brightly_2025.pdf (contract).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199


From: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlyhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, onboarding@brightlyhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 11:04:22 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access pact & kickoff: Brightly Health workspace and API key plan

Thanks Monica — this looks great. Quick answers from our side: 
- Admin user: Emma Li <emma.li@brightlyhealth.com> (I'll be the initial org admin).
- Project name: brightly-staging (agree with your recommendation).
- Service account: Our SRE team prefers a service account with keys stored in HashiCorp Vault; short-lived tokens are ideal.
- SRE contact: onboarding@brightlyhealth.com (please loop them for the IP allowlist / network details).

We can do the kickoff on Nov 11 at 10:00am PT — that works best for SRE. One ask: can Redwood provide both (a) a one-time seeded long-lived key for initial integration testing and (b) instructions to rotate to short-lived keys from Vault? Our compliance team requires a documented rotation path.

Also attaching our internal onboarding contact list in a separate email.

Emma
Emma Li
Director of Platform Engineering | Brightly Health
emma.li@brightlyhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Access pact & kickoff: Brightly Health workspace and API key plan

Ben / Rishi — forwarding Emma's reply. Key points: Emma will be org admin and wants a one-time seeded key plus documented rotation to short-lived Vault tokens. Kickoff scheduled for Nov 11 10:00am PT (tentative).

Request to you both:
- Ben: can you prepare the key-seed runbook (step-by-step commands, curl/SDK snippets, expected token formats) and the file key-seed-instructions.md?
- Rishi: please draft two options in a short doc — (A) Hosted API key seed (long-lived key, rotate every X days) and (B) Service-account-first approach with short-lived tokens and Vault integration. Include rough ETA and cost delta for using Dedicated pool vs Hosted (we quoted both in SOW).

I attached the signed SOW and the rbw_key_seed_template.csv for filling in the admin roles. We'll need the filled template back before the kickoff.

Attachments: SOW_Brightly_2025.pdf, rbw_key_seed_template.csv

Thanks — Monica


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Access pact & kickoff: Brightly Health workspace and API key plan

Monica — thanks for the context. I took a first pass at the seed runbook and attached key-seed-instructions.md. High level notes: 
- I'll prepare a one-time seeded key in the org workspace and mark it as "initial-test-key". We will set ACL to admin-only and note rotation steps.
- For Vault integration, I will include example Vault roles and a short-lived token exchange flow (examples for go/python).
- Estimate: runbook + artifacts ready by EOD Nov 6; seeding can be run during the kickoff on Nov 11.

Attachments: key-seed-instructions.md

Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
